column1: # Legends event-family grammar, reviewed against native DF 53.16.
# The Windows catalogue and shared builders are reviewed at their actual
# sentence branches; see data/extracted/legends-source-review.md for corrections and scope.
# Native narrative catalogue: dwarfort .rodata, file offsets 0x1ce1008–0x1ce5f69
# and 0x1ce8130 onward (long literal continuations). No sampled world names.
# source<TAB>target<TAB>mode: action / event / title / clause / statement / term;
# response / concession compile the reviewed recruitment contrast family.
# action/event compile complete sentences AND clauses, with optional native
# in/at/within/during/wilds suffixes. action also compiles omitted subjects and
# coordinated actions. a=typed person/entity/unnamed creature; s=shared term.
# A worldgen viewport can start in the middle of the previous record. These
# productions apply ONLY at that clipped start, after complete prose fails.
# Translate the visible participant/term and location without inventing the
# missing date, subject or predicate. All vocabulary still uses shared slots.
# Participant relations retain EACH original link instead of flattening a
# person's organization, an army's civilization or a list into one label.
# Injuries: all native severing/wounding variants share one body-part grammar.
# Scoped corrections to BODY imports: do not inherit the Back button's
# translation or swap an anatomical side/orientation from the community PO.
{n}'s {t} was {s} by {a} as a means of torture
{n}'s {t} was {s} as a means of torture by {a}
